A towering construct of black iron forged in the Wardens' deep-foundries beneath what is now the Thornwall. Its body is etched with anchor-runes that still glow faintly — wards against the Rift that have held for millennia. It follows its last received command with mechanical precision, indifferent to the collapse of the civilization that gave it.
## Traits
**Fire Absorption.** Takes no damage from fire, regains HP equal to fire damage instead.
**Immutable Form.** Immune to form-altering effects.
**Magic Resistance.** Advantage on saves against spells.

## Actions
**Multiattack.** Two slam attacks.
**Slam.** +13 to hit, 20 (3d8 + 7) bludgeoning.
**Poison Breath.** 15-foot cone, DC 19 CON save or 45 (10d8) poison (half on success). Recharges 6.
